briefdescription.para: Wrapping flags may allow combining constants separated by an extend.
Fold (1 << NBits) - 1 Into: ~(-(1 << NBits)) Because a 'not' is better for bit-tracking analysis and other transforms than an 'add'.

detaileddescription.para: The new shl is always nsw, and is nuw if old and was.

briefdescription.para: Try to reduce signed division by power-of-2 to an arithmetic shift right.
This is a specialization of a more general transform from foldUsingDistributiveLaws.

detaileddescription.para: If that code can be made to work optimally for multi-use cases or propagating nsw/nuw, then we would not need this.

briefdescription.para: Reduce a sequence of masked half-width multiplies to a single multiply.

detaileddescription.para: ((XLow * YHigh) + (YLow * XHigh)) << HalfBits) + (XLow * YLow) --> X * Y

briefdescription.para: Eliminate an op from a linear interpolation (lerp) pattern.
Factor a common operand out of fadd/fsub of fmul/fdiv.
This eliminates floating-point negation in either 'fneg(X)' or 'fsub(-0.0, X)' form by combining into a constant operand.
